## Open

### T-121 — A page that lists what it observed never re-reads it

> _2026-09-21 · core/blong-realm · open_

Reported as F-227 (realm/blong-gateway): a read taken moments after a call can come back without the
execution that call produced, and the page only reads when it is first opened, so the list a reader
sees is the answer from that moment and nothing refreshes it.

Two things to decide, and they are separate. First, the page: the Flow page — and every page built
on `useRealmRead` without parameters — shows the answer it got on mount, forever. Re-reading when
the page is shown is the behaviour a reader expects from a live list, and it needs the portal to
tell a page that it became active; `Portal.tsx` renders every page with `renderActiveOnly={false}`
and passes only `tabId` and the tab's params, so that is a small addition to the page contract plus
a reason to re-read in the pages that want it. Second, the service: whether `blong.flow.find` lags
the ledger or is served from a snapshot decides whether a caller may assume "I called it, therefore
it is listed"; if it is a snapshot, its interval is what a caller has to wait out, and that belongs
where the read is declared.

The spec no longer depends on either: it retries the produce-and-read pair (`expect(...).toPass`).
